body:
Course-correction: my own prior commit read "double clicking a file in
the nerd tree does not work" as "new-window is the mistake" and
switched file-tree clicks to load in-place. Founder real-time,
directly correcting that: "no double click on nerd tree should open a
new window it just doesnt actually open the real file" -- new-window
IS the real, wanted behavior. Reverted the file-tree click handler
back to spawn_new_instance.

Traced the REAL bug end to end, confirmed live: spawn_new_instance's
own fork+execl DOES correctly re-exec with the target file as argv[1]
(verified directly via a real replica harness -- the child's own
"editor: loaded from <path>" line prints correctly every time). The
actual bug: every window this program creates used SDL_WINDOWPOS_
CENTERED, so a spawned second window opens in the EXACT same screen
position as the still-open first one, perfectly overlapping it --
reads exactly like "nothing happened" even though a real, correctly-
loaded new window is really there. Fixed with SDL_WINDOWPOS_UNDEFINED,
the standard way to let the window manager choose its own placement.

Also fixed a real bug I introduced in the prior O(n^2) read fix,
caught before it caused more damage: fstat-sizing the read buffer up
front means a small file's own initial capacity can be far less than
4096 bytes -- a single `cap * 2` doubling step doesn't reliably leave
`cap >= len + 4096` before the next read() call (unconditional 4096-
byte request), unlike the old fixed-+4096 growth which always held
that invariant. Fixed by looping the doubling step. New regression
test: a real file under 4096 bytes, read back byte-for-byte correct.

Full local suite (336 tests) + test-editor-io (2 new regression
tests) clean. CI green on all 4 jobs after a retrigger (the first run
hit an unrelated, transient apt-mirror infra failure, confirmed from
the real log -- a Chrome apt repo size mismatch, nothing to do with
this repo's own code).

Real, honest status: founder confirmed live this is a partial
improvement ("its like kinda working but not really lets work on it
as an iteration") -- this is a real, verified layer of fixes, not a
claimed full resolution; more specific reproduction detail is needed
before guessing further.

PARENA commit cf3da9c (+ 1618637 empty retrigger). CI run 33117927037:
all 4 jobs green.
